prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering, isometric view from front-below-side, of twin under-deck tuned mass damper on HSFG-clamped cross-beam at work under a footbridge midspan. On a plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop with soft product-shot lighting, show a short clean-cut segment of bridge: horizontal deck soffit slab on top cut off at backdrop, two vertical steel girder webs left and right supporting it. Hanging from the center of the beam are two identical black steel block masses side by side, each about knee-height, each suspended by a tall vertical steel helical coil spring and a parallel smooth stainless viscous damper cylinder between beam hanger and mass top. Small caged black elastomer travel stops with a visible gap sit beside the masses. A tiny deck accelerometer box sits on top of the deck slab at midspan. Include one standing adult person on the backdrop beside the assembly for true scale of the span, no other people or objects. Clean legible callouts, no other text, no numbers, no margins or scale bars.
